authorization: User requested data preparation, verification and a bounded proceed/stop evaluation end-to-end on 2026-09-09. Execute only when prerequisite evidence passes; do not weaken gates.
hypothesis: A positive 60-session ETF price trend predicts positive five-session returns after costs beyond an always-long exposure control.
prior_evidence: Both earlier campaigns remain consumed. 2024-2025 is reused development data and must not be represented as untouched confirmation.
warmup: First 61 exchange sessions of the new interval only. No protected-holdout bars even for lookback. First entry index 61, then every five sessions; final exit must fall within the interval.
registration_rule: Before the new interval starts, all prerequisites must pass and the immutable plan, input policy, source hashes, evaluator hash and single trial budget must be recorded. If the deadline is missed, stop; do not silently roll dates or retrospectively declare data untouched.
signal: At the prior completed close, select the ETF iff previous_close > lookback_close. Equality means cash. No thresholds, models or parameters searched.
observations: Use the four exact observations in the data contract. Reject the entire six-symbol period if any required bar fails. Never move timestamps or replace a missing symbol.
accounting: One sixth of initial notional per ETF; inactive slots stay cash. No compounding, leverage, shorts or intra-symbol overlap. Exit before entry at a shared boundary. These are fixed-notional research markouts, not executable portfolio performance.
cash_baseline: Zero return; cash interest omitted for both strategy and control.
always_long_baseline: All six equal slots on precisely the same accepted entry/exit periods; same price convention and full round-trip cost per active slot.

costs.prerequisite: Establish independent execution-cost evidence for the intended order size, spread, slippage, commissions and fees. If scenarios are not defensible, stop before registration; do not choose new costs after outcomes.

primary_statistics: Mean across common periods of the six-slot strategy return, and paired strategy-minus-always-long return, both at 10 bps. Cash slots contribute zero; do not condition aggregate means on selected trades.

inference.method: Circular moving-block bootstrap of four consecutive common periods, keeping all six symbols and both strategies paired; resample enough blocks and truncate to the original period count.
inference.bounds: Two simultaneous one-sided lower bounds: use the 2.5th percentile for each statistic (Bonferroni family-wise 5 percent).
inference.limitations: Approximate inference; serial dependence and seven-quarter coverage limit confidence. A passing bootstrap does not establish live profitability.

acceptance: Both primary lower bounds strictly positive
Mean strategy return and paired excess over always-long strictly positive at both 20 and 40 bps
At least five quarters have positive net strategy fixed-slot return at 10 bps
At least four symbols have positive net contribution at 10 bps
stopping: One evaluation only, no interim outcome peeks or parameter changes. Insufficient support consumes the trial as inconclusive_budget_consumed. Adequate support with failed acceptance retires this strategy direction. A crash requires artifact audit, not automatic retry.

Full action coverage, adjustment reference/precision and point-in-time signal-price treatment verified
Independent execution-cost evidence supports frozen scenarios
Prospective interval registered before any observations arrive
Evaluator independently tested against hand-calculated corporate-action and paired-baseline fixtures
success_authority: Research candidate for a separate paper execution validation only; no automatic model installation, promotion or orders.
